newsitem.title: USA: RCC to start cellular service in new areas.
newsitem.headline: RCC to start cellular service in new areas.

text.p: Rural Cellular Corp said Wednesday it signed an agreement with US West New Vector Group Inc which will allow it to provide cellular phone service in markets in Minnesota and North Dakota.
Under the agreement, RCC Wireless Co will purchase and resell local cellular radio telecommunications services from US West. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
RCC service in Minneapolis, Duluth and Arrowehead, Minn., and Fargo, Grand Forks and Red River, N.D., is expected to be available in the fourth quarter of 1996, the company said.
